methodology.title: How estimates are calculated
methodology.subtitle: Every estimate is built from your room dimensions, surface conditions, material choices, and regional labor rates. Here is exactly how.

articles.title: Renovation guides
articles.subtitle: Practical knowledge before, during, and after renovation.

items.a: Our estimates are accurate to ±10–15%. This reflects real-world variability in contractor pricing and material costs. The estimate is a budget range, not a fixed price.

items.q: What is included in the estimate?
items.a: Materials, labor, surface preparation, and supporting materials (adhesives, primer, etc.). Regional pricing adjustments for Polish cities are applied automatically.
Structural work, electrical rewiring, plumbing, windows and doors, furniture, appliances, architect or designer fees, and building permits.
About 10 minutes to configure all rooms and receive a full estimate with PDF report.
No. The estimate exists only in your browser session. We do not store room data, personal information, or estimates on our servers.

items.q: How do I get the PDF?
items.a: After completing the estimate, go to the Download screen, enter your email address, and we will send the PDF report to your inbox.

items.q: Can I use this outside Poland?
items.a: The calculator uses Polish market pricing and regional multipliers for Polish cities. It is designed for renovation projects in Poland.

items.q: What does Economy / Standard / Premium mean?
items.a: These are material quality tiers. Economy uses basic, functional materials. Standard is mid-range with a good quality-to-cost ratio. Premium uses high-end, branded, luxury materials.
